description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. 

 CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com .

 The Role 
You’ll join a small, highly collaborative team building the secure cloud platform behind some of the world’s most advanced radar systems. Working alongside software, hardware, and systems engineers, you’ll design and operate the backend services and cloud infrastructure that ingest, process, and deliver mission-critical sensor data at scale. The systems you build must be reliable, resilient, secure, and performant—enabling operators to depend on them in the environments where they matter most.
This is a high-ownership role where you’ll influence architecture, build production systems, and help define the engineering foundations of a rapidly evolving platform. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy solving hard infrastructure problems, scaling distributed systems, and building software that performs under demanding real-world conditions.

 
 What You’ll Build 

 
 Cloud Platform – Design, build, and operate secure, scalable Azure infrastructure that powers distributed radar systems and backend services.

 Backend Services – Develop high-performance services that ingest, process, and distribute real-time sensor data with low latency, high reliability, and security at scale.

 Infrastructure & Automation – Define infrastructure as code, automate deployments, and continuously improve the platform through modern DevOps practices.

 Reliability & Operations – Own observability, monitoring, resiliency, and operational readiness, ensuring production systems remain secure, scalable, and dependable in demanding environments.

 Platform Architecture – Help shape the technical direction of the platform, making architectural decisions that support new capabilities, increasing scale, and long-term maintainability.

 Cross-Functional Integration – Partner closely with software, hardware, and systems engineers to deliver secure, reliable end-to-end capabilities from sensor to cloud.

 
 What We’re Looking For 
We’re looking for exceptional backend and cloud engineers who are excited by solving hard technical problems and building systems that matter. You don’t need experience with every technology we use—we value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.
You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 
 Enjoy building scalable backend systems and taking ownership of production services.

 Enjoy solving complex cloud infrastructure and distributed systems challenges.

 Are eager to learn new technologies and adapt to new technical domains.

 Care deeply about reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence.

 Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across software, hardware, and systems engineering teams.

 Are motivated by building technology with meaningful real-world impact.

 
 Experience in one or more of the following is a plus: 

 
 Python and modern backend development.

 Azure or another major cloud platform.

 Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD.

 Real-time data pipelines or distributed systems.

 Frontend development using modern web technologies (TypeScript/React) or a willingness to work across the stack when needed.

 
 Requirements: 

 
 Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen or permanent resident), as required for access to controlled technology.

 Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

 
 
Why CHAOS? 

 
 Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

 Additional benefits : 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

 Our Perks: Free daily lunch, ‘No meeting Fridays’, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

 Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

 Team Growth: 250 employees and counting across 5 global offices

 
 $130k-220k 

 The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.  

  

 
 Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.
